preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
The size of the matrix n must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(b[i][j]) <= 1 for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
preconditions.description: All elements of the binary matrix b must be either 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: len(A) == n and all(len(A[i]) >= 1 for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: There must be n sets, each containing at least one distinct integer.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(A[i])) == len(A[i]) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each set must contain distinct integers.

postconditions.expression: all(A[i] != A[j] for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if i != j)
all((b[i][j] == 1) == (set(A[i]) < set(A[j])) for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
postconditions.description: The binary matrix b must correctly represent the proper subset relationships between sets.
